# archestra_agent (Data Source)

Lookup an existing agent by UUID. Works across all three agent variants (`archestra_agent`, `archestra_llm_proxy`, `archestra_mcp_gateway`) — inspect `agent_type` to discriminate. Useful for cross-stack references without `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup a known agent by ID. Works across all three agent variants
# (archestra_agent, archestra_llm_proxy, archestra_mcp_gateway) — check
# `agent_type` to discriminate.
data "archestra_agent" "support" {
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-a111-111111111111"
}

output "support_agent_name" {
  value = data.archestra_agent.support.name
}

output "support_team_count" {
  value = length(data.archestra_agent.support.team_ids)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Agent UUID.

### Read-Only

- `agent_type` (String) Variant discriminator: `agent`, `llm_proxy`, `mcp_gateway`, or `profile` (legacy).
- `built_in` (Boolean) True when the agent is a platform built-in.
- `connector_ids` (List of String)
- `consider_context_untrusted` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String)
- `icon` (String)
- `incoming_email_allowed_domain` (String)
- `incoming_email_enabled` (Boolean)
- `incoming_email_security_mode` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean) True when this is the default agent for its `agent_type`.
- `knowledge_base_ids` (List of String)
- `labels` (Map of String) Flat `key → value` label map. Backend stores labels as a list of `{key, value}` pairs but this data source projects them into a map for HCL ergonomics — duplicate keys collapse to the last-seen value.
- `llm_api_key_id` (String)
- `llm_model` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `scope` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `system_prompt` (String)
- `team_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of teams this agent is assigned to (only populated when `scope = "team"`).
